definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture with a flat surface for writing, reading, or working. Common in offices, schools, and homes.

examples.english: There's a book on the desk.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}します→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{机|つくえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: This desk is big, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{汚|きたな}い→汚い：00788_kitanai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{掃除|そうじ}しなければなりません→掃除：02889_souji⟧。
examples.english: My desk is messy, so I have to clean it up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{机|つくえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いたい→買う：00489_kau⟧けど、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ので⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。⟦{困|こま}っています→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I want to buy a new desk, but my room is small so there's no place to put it. I'm in trouble.

notes:
{机|つくえ} refers to a desk for work or study, distinct from テーブル (table) which is for dining or general use.

CONTRAST:
- {机|つくえ}: desk (for work/study, typically has drawers)
- テーブル: table (for dining, meetings, general use)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧{机|づくえ}: study desk
- {事務|じむ}{机|づくえ}: office desk
- {机|つくえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: on the desk
- {机|つくえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し: desk drawer

COUNTER:
⟦{台|だい}→〜台：00620_dai⟧ is used to count desks: {机|つくえ}{一台|いちだい} (one desk)

IDIOM:
{机上|きじょう}の{空論|くうろん}: armchair theory (impractical theory)
